blocks.source: Canto XXIII
blocks.translation: Canto XXIII

blocks.source: Taciti, soli, sanza compagnia
blocks.translation: Silent, alone, and without company

blocks.source: n’andavam l’un dinanzi e l’altro dopo,
blocks.translation: We went, the one in front, the other after,

blocks.source: come frati minor vanno per via.
blocks.translation: As go the Minor Friars along their way.

blocks.source: Vòlt’ era in su la favola d’Isopo
blocks.translation: Upon the fable of Aesop was directed

blocks.source: lo mio pensier per la presente rissa,
blocks.translation: My thought, by reason of the present quarrel,

blocks.source: dov’ el parlò de la rana e del topo;
blocks.translation: Where he has spoken of the frog and mouse;

blocks.source: ché più non si pareggia ‘mo’ e ‘issa’
blocks.translation: For ‘mo’ and ‘issa’ are not more alike

blocks.source: che l’un con l’altro fa, se ben s’accoppia
blocks.translation: Than this one is to that, if well we couple

blocks.source: principio e fine con la mente fissa.
blocks.translation: End and beginning with a steadfast mind.

blocks.source: E come l’un pensier de l’altro scoppia,
blocks.translation: And even as one thought from another springs,

blocks.source: così nacque di quello un altro poi,
blocks.translation: So afterward from that was born another,

blocks.source: che la prima paura mi fé doppia.
blocks.translation: Which the first fear within me double made.

blocks.source: Io pensava così: ‘Questi per noi
blocks.translation: Thus did I ponder: “These on our account

blocks.source: sono scherniti con danno e con beffa
blocks.translation: Are laughed to scorn, with injury and scoff

blocks.source: sì fatta, ch’assai credo che lor nòi.
blocks.translation: So great, that much I think it must annoy them.

blocks.source: Se l’ira sovra ’l mal voler s’aggueffa,
blocks.translation: If anger be engrafted on ill-will,

blocks.source: ei ne verranno dietro più crudeli
blocks.translation: They will come after us more merciless

blocks.source: che ’l cane a quella lievre ch’elli acceffa’.
blocks.translation: Than dog upon the leveret which he seizes,”

blocks.source: Già mi sentia tutti arricciar li peli
blocks.translation: I felt my hair stand all on end already

blocks.source: de la paura e stava in dietro intento,
blocks.translation: With terror, and stood backwardly intent,

blocks.source: quand’ io dissi: «Maestro, se non celi
blocks.translation: When said I: “Master, if thou hidest not

blocks.source: te e me tostamente, i’ ho pavento
blocks.translation: Thyself and me forthwith, of Malebranche

blocks.source: d’i Malebranche. Noi li avem già dietro;
blocks.translation: I am in dread; we have them now behind us;

blocks.source: io li ’magino sì, che già li sento».
blocks.translation: I so imagine them, I already feel them.”

blocks.source: E quei: «S’i’ fossi di piombato vetro,
blocks.translation: And he: “If I were made of leaded glass,

blocks.source: l’imagine di fuor tua non trarrei
blocks.translation: Thine outward image I should not attract

blocks.source: più tosto a me, che quella dentro ’mpetro.
blocks.translation: Sooner to me than I imprint the inner.

blocks.source: Pur mo venieno i tuo’ pensier tra ’ miei,
blocks.translation: Just now thy thoughts came in among my own,

blocks.source: con simile atto e con simile faccia,
blocks.translation: With similar attitude and similar face,

blocks.source: sì che d’intrambi un sol consiglio fei.
blocks.translation: So that of both one counsel sole I made.

blocks.source: S’elli è che sì la destra costa giaccia,
blocks.translation: If peradventure the right bank so slope

blocks.source: che noi possiam ne l’altra bolgia scendere,
blocks.translation: That we to the next Bolgia can descend,

blocks.source: noi fuggirem l’imaginata caccia».
blocks.translation: We shall escape from the imagined chase.”

blocks.source: Già non compié di tal consiglio rendere,
blocks.translation: Not yet he finished rendering such opinion,

blocks.source: ch’io li vidi venir con l’ali tese
blocks.translation: When I beheld them come with outstretched wings,

blocks.source: non molto lungi, per volerne prendere.
blocks.translation: Not far remote, with will to seize upon us.

blocks.source: Lo duca mio di sùbito mi prese,
blocks.translation: My Leader on a sudden seized me up,

blocks.source: come la madre ch’al romore è desta
blocks.translation: Even as a mother who by noise is wakened,

blocks.source: e vede presso a sé le fiamme accese,
blocks.translation: And close beside her sees the enkindled flames,

blocks.source: che prende il figlio e fugge e non s’arresta,
blocks.translation: Who takes her son, and flies, and does not stop,

blocks.source: avendo più di lui che di sé cura,
blocks.translation: Having more care of him than of herself,

blocks.source: tanto che solo una camiscia vesta;
blocks.translation: So that she clothes her only with a shift;

blocks.source: e giù dal collo de la ripa dura
blocks.translation: And downward from the top of the hard bank

blocks.source: supin si diede a la pendente roccia,
blocks.translation: Supine he gave him to the pendent rock,

blocks.source: che l’un de’ lati a l’altra bolgia tura.
blocks.translation: That one side of the other Bolgia walls.

blocks.source: Non corse mai sì tosto acqua per doccia
blocks.translation: Ne’er ran so swiftly water through a sluice

blocks.source: a volger ruota di molin terragno,
blocks.translation: To turn the wheel of any land-built mill,

blocks.source: quand’ ella più verso le pale approccia,
blocks.translation: When nearest to the paddles it approaches,

blocks.source: come ’l maestro mio per quel vivagno,
blocks.translation: As did my Master down along that border,

blocks.source: portandosene me sovra ’l suo petto,
blocks.translation: Bearing me with him on his breast away,

blocks.source: come suo figlio, non come compagno.
blocks.translation: As his own son, and not as a companion.

blocks.source: A pena fuoro i piè suoi giunti al letto
blocks.translation: Hardly the bed of the ravine below

blocks.source: del fondo giù, ch’e’ furon in sul colle
blocks.translation: His feet had reached, ere they had reached the hill

blocks.source: sovresso noi; ma non lì era sospetto:
blocks.translation: Right over us; but there was naught to fear;

blocks.source: ché l’alta provedenza che lor volle
blocks.translation: For the high Providence, which had ordained

blocks.source: porre ministri de la fossa quinta,
blocks.translation: To place them ministers of the fifth moat,

blocks.source: poder di partirs’ indi a tutti tolle.
blocks.translation: The power of thence departing took from all.

blocks.source: Là giù trovammo una gente dipinta
blocks.translation: A painted people there below we found,

blocks.source: che giva intorno assai con lenti passi,
blocks.translation: Who went about with footsteps very slow,

blocks.source: piangendo e nel sembiante stanca e vinta.
blocks.translation: Weeping and in their semblance tired and vanquished.

blocks.source: Elli avean cappe con cappucci bassi
blocks.translation: They had on mantles with the hoods low down

blocks.source: dinanzi a li occhi, fatte de la taglia
blocks.translation: Before their eyes, and fashioned of the cut

blocks.source: che in Clugnì per li monaci fassi.
blocks.translation: That at Cluny is fashioned for the monks.

blocks.source: Di fuor dorate son, sì ch’elli abbaglia;
blocks.translation: Without, they gilded are so that it dazzles;

blocks.source: ma dentro tutte piombo, e gravi tanto,
blocks.translation: But inwardly all leaden and so heavy

blocks.source: che Federigo le mettea di paglia.
blocks.translation: That Frederick’s were but straw compared with these.

blocks.source: Oh in etterno faticoso manto!
blocks.translation: O everlastingly fatiguing mantle!

blocks.source: Noi ci volgemmo ancor pur a man manca
blocks.translation: Again we turned us, still to the left hand

blocks.source: con loro insieme, intenti al tristo pianto;
blocks.translation: Along with them, intent on their sad plaint;

blocks.source: ma per lo peso quella gente stanca
blocks.translation: But owing to the weight, that weary folk

blocks.source: venìa sì pian, che noi eravam nuovi
blocks.translation: Came on so tardily, that we were new

blocks.source: di compagnia ad ogne mover d’anca.
blocks.translation: In company at each motion of the haunch.

blocks.source: Per ch’io al duca mio: «Fa che tu trovi
blocks.translation: Whence I unto my Leader: “See thou find

blocks.source: alcun ch’al fatto o al nome si conosca,
blocks.translation: Some one who may by deed or name be known,

blocks.source: e li occhi, sì andando, intorno movi».
blocks.translation: And thus in going move thine eye about.”

blocks.source: E un che ’ntese la parola tosca,
blocks.translation: And one, who understood the Tuscan speech,

blocks.source: di retro a noi gridò: «Tenete i piedi,
blocks.translation: Cried to us from behind: “Stay ye your feet,

blocks.source: voi che correte sì per l’aura fosca!
blocks.translation: Ye, who so run athwart the dusky air!

blocks.source: Forse ch’avrai da me quel che tu chiedi».
blocks.translation: Perhaps thou’lt have from me what thou demandest.”

blocks.source: Onde ’l duca si volse e disse: «Aspetta,
blocks.translation: Whereat the Leader turned him, and said: “Wait,

blocks.source: e poi secondo il suo passo procedi».
blocks.translation: And then according to his pace proceed.”

blocks.source: Ristetti, e vidi due mostrar gran fretta
blocks.translation: I stopped, and two beheld I show great haste

blocks.source: de l’animo, col viso, d’esser meco;
blocks.translation: Of spirit, in their faces, to be with me;

blocks.source: ma tardavali ’l carco e la via stretta.
blocks.translation: But the burden and the narrow way delayed them.

blocks.source: Quando fuor giunti, assai con l’occhio bieco
blocks.translation: When they came up, long with an eye askance

blocks.source: mi rimiraron sanza far parola;
blocks.translation: They scanned me without uttering a word.

blocks.source: poi si volsero in sé, e dicean seco:
blocks.translation: Then to each other turned, and said together:

blocks.source: «Costui par vivo a l’atto de la gola;
blocks.translation: “He by the action of his throat seems living;

blocks.source: e s’e’ son morti, per qual privilegio
blocks.translation: And if they dead are, by what privilege

blocks.source: vanno scoperti de la grave stola?».
blocks.translation: Go they uncovered by the heavy stole?”

blocks.source: Poi disser me: «O Tosco, ch’al collegio
blocks.translation: Then said to me: “Tuscan, who to the college

blocks.source: de l’ipocriti tristi se’ venuto,
blocks.translation: Of miserable hypocrites art come,

blocks.source: dir chi tu se’ non avere in dispregio».
blocks.translation: Do not disdain to tell us who thou art.”

blocks.source: E io a loro: «I’ fui nato e cresciuto
blocks.translation: And I to them: “Born was I, and grew up

blocks.source: sovra ’l bel fiume d’Arno a la gran villa,
blocks.translation: In the great town on the fair river of Arno,

blocks.source: e son col corpo ch’i’ ho sempre avuto.
blocks.translation: And with the body am I’ve always had.

blocks.source: Ma voi chi siete, a cui tanto distilla
blocks.translation: But who are ye, in whom there trickles down

blocks.source: quant’ i’ veggio dolor giù per le guance?
blocks.translation: Along your cheeks such grief as I behold?

blocks.source: e che pena è in voi che sì sfavilla?».
blocks.translation: And what pain is upon you, that so sparkles?”

blocks.source: E l’un rispuose a me: «Le cappe rance
blocks.translation: And one replied to me: “These orange cloaks

blocks.source: son di piombo sì grosse, che li pesi
blocks.translation: Are made of lead so heavy, that the weights

blocks.source: fan così cigolar le lor bilance.
blocks.translation: Cause in this way their balances to creak.

blocks.source: Frati godenti fummo, e bolognesi;
blocks.translation: Frati Gaudenti were we, and Bolognese;

blocks.source: io Catalano e questi Loderingo
blocks.translation: I Catalano, and he Loderingo

blocks.source: nomati, e da tua terra insieme presi
blocks.translation: Named, and together taken by thy city,

blocks.source: come suole esser tolto un uom solingo,
blocks.translation: As the wont is to take one man alone,

blocks.source: per conservar sua pace; e fummo tali,
blocks.translation: For maintenance of its peace; and we were such

blocks.source: ch’ancor si pare intorno dal Gardingo».
blocks.translation: That still it is apparent round Gardingo.”

blocks.source: Io cominciai: «O frati, i vostri mali . . . »;
blocks.translation: “O Friars,” began I, “your iniquitous. . .”

blocks.source: ma più non dissi, ch’a l’occhio mi corse
blocks.translation: But said no more; for to mine eyes there rushed

blocks.source: un, crucifisso in terra con tre pali.
blocks.translation: One crucified with three stakes on the ground.

blocks.source: Quando mi vide, tutto si distorse,
blocks.translation: When me he saw, he writhed himself all over,

blocks.source: soffiando ne la barba con sospiri;
blocks.translation: Blowing into his beard with suspirations;

blocks.source: e ’l frate Catalan, ch’a ciò s’accorse,
blocks.translation: And the Friar Catalan, who noticed this,

blocks.source: mi disse: «Quel confitto che tu miri,
blocks.translation: Said to me: “This transfixed one, whom thou seest,

blocks.source: consigliò i Farisei che convenia
blocks.translation: Counselled the Pharisees that it was meet

blocks.source: porre un uom per lo popolo a’ martìri.
blocks.translation: To put one man to torture for the people.

blocks.source: Attraversato è, nudo, ne la via,
blocks.translation: Crosswise and naked is he on the path,

blocks.source: come tu vedi, ed è mestier ch’el senta
blocks.translation: As thou perceivest; and he needs must feel,

blocks.source: qualunque passa, come pesa, pria.
blocks.translation: Whoever passes, first how much he weighs;

blocks.source: E a tal modo il socero si stenta
blocks.translation: And in like mode his father-in-law is punished

blocks.source: in questa fossa, e li altri dal concilio
blocks.translation: Within this moat, and the others of the council,

blocks.source: che fu per li Giudei mala sementa».
blocks.translation: Which for the Jews was a malignant seed.”

blocks.source: Allor vid’ io maravigliar Virgilio
blocks.translation: And thereupon I saw Virgilius marvel

blocks.source: sovra colui ch’era disteso in croce
blocks.translation: O’er him who was extended on the cross

blocks.source: tanto vilmente ne l’etterno essilio.
blocks.translation: So vilely in eternal banishment.

blocks.source: Poscia drizzò al frate cotal voce:
blocks.translation: Then he directed to the Friar this voice:

blocks.source: «Non vi dispiaccia, se vi lece, dirci
blocks.translation: “Be not displeased, if granted thee, to tell us

blocks.source: s’a la man destra giace alcuna foce
blocks.translation: If to the right hand any pass slope down

blocks.source: onde noi amendue possiamo uscirci,
blocks.translation: By which we two may issue forth from here,

blocks.source: sanza costrigner de li angeli neri
blocks.translation: Without constraining some of the black angels

blocks.source: che vegnan d’esto fondo a dipartirci».
blocks.translation: To come and extricate us from this deep.”

blocks.source: Rispuose adunque: «Più che tu non speri
blocks.translation: Then he made answer: “Nearer than thou hopest

blocks.source: s’appressa un sasso che da la gran cerchia
blocks.translation: There is a rock, that forth from the great circle

blocks.source: si move e varca tutt’ i vallon feri,
blocks.translation: Proceeds, and crosses all the cruel valleys,

blocks.source: salvo che ’n questo è rotto e nol coperchia;
blocks.translation: Save that at this ’tis broken, and does not bridge it;

blocks.source: montar potrete su per la ruina,
blocks.translation: You will be able to mount up the ruin,

blocks.source: che giace in costa e nel fondo soperchia».
blocks.translation: That sidelong slopes and at the bottom rises.”

blocks.source: Lo duca stette un poco a testa china;
blocks.translation: The Leader stood awhile with head bowed down;

blocks.source: poi disse: «Mal contava la bisogna
blocks.translation: Then said: “The business badly he recounted

blocks.source: colui che i peccator di qua uncina».
blocks.translation: Who grapples with his hook the sinners yonder.”

blocks.source: E ’l frate: «Io udi’ già dire a Bologna
blocks.translation: And the Friar: “Many of the Devil’s vices

blocks.source: del diavol vizi assai, tra ’ quali udi’
blocks.translation: Once heard I at Bologna, and among them,

blocks.source: ch’elli è bugiardo, e padre di menzogna».
blocks.translation: That he’s a liar and the father of lies.”

blocks.source: Appresso il duca a gran passi sen gì,
blocks.translation: Thereat my Leader with great strides went on,

blocks.source: turbato un poco d’ira nel sembiante;
blocks.translation: Somewhat disturbed with anger in his looks;

blocks.source: ond’ io da li ’ncarcati mi parti’
blocks.translation: Whence from the heavy-laden I departed

blocks.source: dietro a le poste de le care piante.
blocks.translation: After the prints of his beloved feet.
